method: Manual visual audit (2026-11-02): 5 evenly spaced REJECT frames from every video that had rejections, judged for whether an adult is the dominant person in view.
summary: VID_002 shows a clinician holding the infant: its rejections are correct. In VID_001, VID_005, VID_013, VID_026 and VID_029 only the infant (at most an adult hand) is visible: those rejections are false.
